summary: Final update, validated (valid; single effect: the dependency list of the recovery-value family fact). It refreshes that fact's pointers so a reader following them lands on the current statements: the empty-slice behaviour entry 2b0dd5bd now resolves to revision 6 (trigger-position rule plus the post-trigger counting statement) instead of the superseded revision 4, and the assertion text there records that no later reply can re-open the decision; the status-guard entry (cbbf11dd, revision 3) and the recovery-versus-committed-value finding (ed76b573, revision 2) were already current and are unchanged. No statement, condition, source or citation of the fact moved. Audit state at the end of the run: six registered questions, all with explained dispositions and receipts - the recovery value-adoption defect (a recovery lacking the command replacing the quorum-reported value with a NOOP, up to a completed contradiction of another live replica's committed value), recovery authority bounded by the recoverer's fixed ballot with no repair on the rejection path, the status-guard stall that clears only on the executor's retry, the empty-slice replacement whose outcome equals the reply adopted at the slow-quorum trigger position (all six permutations of the three-reply set and four orders of the two-carrier/two-empty set agree, counts do not decide, and only N - SlowQuorumSize replies can arrive afterwards so the adoption is final), the client completion contract that holds for the single-NOOP case through the re-offer path but not for the empty batch, and the wrong-row write in handlePreAccept refuted as unreachable in this snapshot. Five executed receipts (81a44ff6, 098ab442, e89ecb07, 251562364, 2ba5ed47) carry the citations, the captured source tree was never modified, and the harness drafts used are frozen as fixed experiments under the run.
